cli.description: Extract Bilibili video subtitles for a time range, save as text and a readable HTML page.
cli.url-help: Bilibili video URL or BV id
cli.end-help: Range end, same format as start
cli.model-help: Whisper model name for ASR fallback (default: small)
cli.device-help: ASR device: cpu or cuda (default: auto)
cli.language-help: Speech language hint for ASR (default: zh)
cli.sessdata-help: Bilibili SESSDATA cookie, enables official/AI subtitles
cli.no-asr-help: Only use official subtitles, never fall back to ASR
cli.force-asr-help: Skip official subtitles and always use ASR
cli.title: Bilibili video to text
cli.hotwords-help: Space-separated names or terms to bias ASR.
cli.cookies-help: Path to a Netscape cookies.txt file.
cli.doc-description: Extract Bilibili subtitles for a time range and turn them into a structured document.

log.no-official-subtitles: No accessible official subtitles, falling back to ASR.
log.empty-result: No speech detected in the selected range.
log.subtitle-url-missing: Subtitle URL missing, falling back to ASR.
log.cuda-fallback: GPU unavailable, falling back to CPU.

error.error.no-bv: No BV id found in the provided URL.
error.error.end-before-start: End time must be greater than start time.
error.error.audio-extract: Failed to extract any audio for the requested range.
error.error.playurl: No playable audio source returned (the video may be region locked).
error.error.requests-missing: Missing dependency 'requests'. Run: pip install -r workflow/requirements.txt
error.error.whisper-missing: Missing dependency 'faster-whisper'. Run: pip install -r workflow/requirements.txt

doc.speaker: Speaker
doc.disclaimer: This document was generated automatically from the video subtitles and may contain errors. Please refer to the original video.
doc.fetching-subtitles: Trying to fetch AI subtitles with yt-dlp...
doc.no-cookies: No browser cookies supplied, skipping AI subtitles.
doc.using-asr: Generating the document from local speech recognition.
doc.auto-chapters: No outline supplied, splitting by pauses.
doc.no-subtitle-tools: yt-dlp is not installed, skipping AI subtitles.
doc.checking-api: Checking the player API for subtitles...
doc.subtitles-out-of-range: Subtitles do not cover the requested range, falling back to speech recognition.
